summary: GitHub Copilot Fusion is generally available. Instead of picking a model for each task, choose Copilot Fusion and let Copilot intelligently route and orchestrate which models it uses for you.
takeaways: Copilot Fusion brings together Project HydraFusion’s multi-model orchestration and Copilot auto model selection’s fine-tuned model selection, leveraging the benefits of both to balance performance and cost efficiency.

We’ve also seen its decision-making improve over time, giving developers greater confidence to focus on their work while Copilot handles model selection.” Hari Pokhrel, Principal Software Engineer, AT&T Billing When you use Copilot Fusion you’re billed for each model it uses, at each model’s standard rate.
